questions.prompt: What does Gemini Apps Help say you can ask Gemini Apps for when you learn?

options.text: Questions to practise, plus feedback and hints
options.explanation: Right. You can also ask for specific quiz types, like multiple choice.

options.text: A certificate that you passed the course
options.explanation: The page does not say Gemini gives certificates.

options.text: The marks your teacher gave other learners
options.explanation: The page says nothing like this. It is about practice for you.

questions.prompt: The Claude Help Center article on Claude for Education says Claude should not be used for what?

options.text: Explaining hard ideas in simpler words
options.explanation: The page lists this as a good study use.

options.text: Writing quiz questions about the course
options.explanation: The page lists this as a good study use.

options.text: Doing assignments you must do on your own
options.explanation: Right. It says to follow your university's academic integrity policies.

questions.prompt: Where do Claude project instructions apply?

options.text: To every chat in your whole account
options.explanation: That is "Instructions for Claude", the account-wide setting.

options.text: Only inside the chats of that project
options.explanation: Right. The ChatGPT docs say the same for ChatGPT projects.

options.text: Only to the first chat in the project
options.explanation: They apply to every chat in the project, not only the first one.
